license_rule: Public Domain / CC0 / CC BY only. CC BY-SA, NC, ND, unknown, uncredited, watermark/text/logo images excluded.

screens.query: Japan drained irrigation pond mud flat shallow pools fishing net kaibori
screens.subject: A real wide documentary photograph of a drained Japanese farm pond, with exposed muddy bottom, residual shallow pools, and a work net visible together in one frame. Not a television screenshot.

screens.query: pond drainage large freshwater fish lifted net muddy pond hands
screens.subject: One real documentary photograph showing a large freshwater fish being lifted from a drained muddy pond with a net or human hand visible for scale. No collage.

screens.query: calm pond mirror reflection sky trees water surface
screens.subject: A quiet natural pond photographed near water level. The sky and trees are reflected clearly on the surface, while the underwater world remains hidden.
screens.title: Parallel
screens.author: Ian Sane
screens.credit: Parallel by Ian Sane, CC BY 2.0, via https://www.flickr.com/photos/31246066@N04/4478016596

visual_verification.actual_subject: A quiet natural pond with clear reflections
visual_verification.reason: The image depicts a natural pond with reflections of trees and the sky, aligning with the expected subject.

screens.query: Sunabachi Pond Inotaka Ryokuchi Nagoya Japan pond
screens.subject: A real photograph of Sunabachi Pond in Inotaka Ryokuchi, Nagoya, Japan. The specific pond should be recognizable; show its water surface or exposed basin broadly. Do not substitute another pond.

screens.query: Inokashira Pond Tokyo aquatic plants underwater kaibori
screens.subject: A real photograph of Inokashira Pond in Tokyo and aquatic plants that returned after pond restoration. Prefer a submerged view with plant leaves above the pond bottom. Do not substitute another location if the source claims to show Inokashira.

screens.query: Japanese irrigation pond draining sluice gate water release mud
screens.subject: A wide real photograph of a pond being drained for maintenance, with water flowing out through a sluice or outlet and the pond bottom beginning to emerge.

screens.query: traditional Japanese pond maintenance kaibori mud removal community
screens.subject: One documentary photograph of local people traditionally maintaining a Japanese irrigation pond: removing mud, catching fish, or inspecting the embankment and water channel.

screens.query: underwater pond bottom accumulated sediment leaf litter detritus
screens.subject: A real underwater photograph looking across a pond bottom where layers of soft mud and fallen leaves have accumulated, with the water surface or upper water column visible.

screens.query: pond dredging mud removal clear underwater sunlight aquatic plants
screens.subject: A single real photograph that shows pond-bottom mud removal or dredging together with clear water, sunlight reaching underwater aquatic plants. Prefer a genuine underwater view rather than a composite.

screens.query: drained pond basin workers digging mud drying pond bottom
screens.subject: A low-angle documentary photograph of workers digging or inspecting mud on a drained pond bed, showing the drying ground and the breadth of the exposed basin.

screens.query: wet pond mud sediment close up plant seeds fragments macro
screens.subject: A macro photograph of moist pond sediment. Small seeds or plant fragments should be visible or plausibly identifiable in the mud texture; no labels or text.

screens.query: aquatic plant seed germinating muddy soil macro seedling
screens.subject: A real macro photograph of a small aquatic plant seedling germinating from wet mud, with seed coat, emerging root, and green shoot visible together.

screens.query: Inokashira Park Tokyo postwar historical aerial photograph urban development
screens.subject: A genuine historical aerial photograph or historical map-like aerial image of the area around Inokashira Park in Tokyo during postwar urban development. The image should show the pond area and expanding city around it.

screens.query: Inokashira Pond kaibori 2014 January March drained pond
screens.subject: A real archival photograph from the January–March 2014 kaibori at Inokashira Pond, Tokyo, showing lowered water and the actually exposed pond bottom.

screens.query: Inokashira Pond 2014 kaibori workers remove trash invasive fish
screens.subject: A documentary photograph of the 2014 Inokashira Pond kaibori work, with workers removing trash or invasive organisms from the exposed pond basin. No TV frame or article screenshot.

screens.query: Chara charophyte Potamogeton perfoliatus aquatic plant close up
screens.subject: A real close-up photograph of either Chara (stonewort/charophyte) or Potamogeton perfoliatus (broad-leaved pondweed), with the plant's actual leaves and stems clearly visible.

screens.query: aquatic plant seeds sediment soil seed bank macro photograph
screens.subject: A macro photograph of dormant aquatic plant seeds embedded in wet mud or sediment. The seeds are the main subject, with muddy particles visible behind them.

screens.query: clear pond underwater sunlight aquatic plants water clarity
screens.subject: A real underwater photograph of clear pond water where sunlight from the surface reaches aquatic plant leaves. Water should be relatively transparent and the plants visible.

screens.query: small freshwater fish hiding submerged aquatic vegetation underwater
screens.subject: A real underwater photograph of small freshwater fish sheltering among dense submerged aquatic plants. Fish and leaves must both be visible in the same frame.

screens.query: Pseudorasbora parva fry juvenile fish little grebe chick pond
screens.subject: One real nature photograph showing either clearly identifiable Pseudorasbora parva (topmouth gudgeon) fry, or a little grebe parent with its chick on a pond. Choose one subject, not a collage.

screens.query: Inokashira Pond Tokyo restored aquatic plants waterweed
screens.subject: A real photograph of Inokashira Pond after aquatic plants returned, with aquatic vegetation in the foreground and the pond surface in the background. Avoid an idealized stock scene.

screens.query: Pseudorasbora parva juvenile topmouth gudgeon fry aquatic plants
screens.subject: A real underwater photograph of juvenile Pseudorasbora parva (topmouth gudgeon) swimming among aquatic plants. The small fish and vegetation should be visible together.

screens.query: red swamp crayfish Procambarus clarkii eating aquatic plant
screens.subject: A real photograph of an American red swamp crayfish (Procambarus clarkii) feeding on or cutting aquatic vegetation. If feeding is not visible, its claws gripping a water plant are acceptable.

screens.query: Inokashira Pond invasive fish crayfish survey removal volunteers
screens.subject: A real documentary photograph of a citizen group continuing invasive fish or crayfish surveys and control work at Inokashira Pond, preferably checking and recording a catch.

screens.query: Kasamatsu Tonbo Tengoku pond draining volunteer conservation event Gifu
screens.subject: A real wide photograph of volunteers entering a pond during a nature-conservation pond-draining event at Kasamatsu Tonbo Tengoku, Gifu Prefecture. It should look like a field event, not a TV broadcast.

screens.query: Kasamatsu Tonbo Tengoku biotope pond Gifu Japan wetland
screens.subject: A real photograph of Kasamatsu Tonbo Tengoku in Kasamatsu, Gifu, showing the actual biotope pond, wetland, and waterside vegetation in a wide view.

screens.query: dragonfly nymph larva underwater freshwater fish invasive species
screens.subject: A real nature photograph of a dragonfly nymph (aquatic larva) underwater, or a clear freshwater underwater scene showing fish in the same habitat. Prefer a clearly recognizable nymph.

screens.query: large group community volunteers wading pond conservation event Japan
screens.subject: A single wide or elevated documentary photograph of a large group of local residents and children wading into a pond during a conservation or pond-cleaning event. The scale and number of participants should be obvious.

screens.query: pond volunteers wading searching catching fish muddy water conservation
screens.subject: A real documentary photograph of volunteers wading in a pond and searching for fish. Show both the people and the crowded working conditions in one frame.

screens.query: fish holding containers buckets temporary storage pond survey
screens.subject: A real field photograph of buckets or tubs used to temporarily hold fish caught during a pond survey. The number and size of the containers should be clear.

screens.query: freshwater fish identification field survey gloved hand fish guide
screens.subject: A real documentary photograph of a gloved researcher carefully holding a freshwater fish while identifying its species using a field guide or identification sheet. Any paper should not contain prominent readable text.

screens.query: freshwater fish conservation catch containers field recording survey
screens.subject: A real field photograph showing containers used for caught fish and a field record sheet during a conservation survey. Avoid TV screenshots, article screenshots, and prominent readable text.

screens.query: pond draining fishing nets empty fish holding tubs aeration equipment
screens.subject: A real documentary photograph showing fish-catching nets alongside empty temporary holding tubs or buckets and oxygen/aeration equipment, suggesting preparation gaps. No staged collage.

screens.query: Sunabachi Pond Inotaka Ryokuchi Nagoya aerial pond landscape
screens.subject: A real wide photograph of Sunabachi Pond in Inotaka Ryokuchi, Nagoya, showing the pond's shape and surrounding green space. The specific pond must be identifiable.

screens.query: Sunabachi Pond 2021 bluegill capture pond draining Inotaka Ryokuchi
screens.subject: A real photograph from the November 2021 pond-draining at Sunabachi Pond, Inotaka Ryokuchi, showing bluegill being caught with a net or in a container. Do not use an unrelated fish catch.

screens.query: Sunabachi Pond Inotaka Ryokuchi 2023 pond Nagoya water surface
screens.subject: A real photograph of Sunabachi Pond in Inotaka Ryokuchi, Nagoya, around 2023, showing its water surface and subtle fish shadows. Do not substitute a different pond.

screens.query: Hyogo Prefecture Japan irrigation ponds aerial landscape pond cluster
screens.subject: A real aerial or elevated landscape photograph of multiple agricultural irrigation ponds in Hyogo Prefecture, Japan, with enough surrounding land to suggest a regional group of ponds.

screens.query: dam reservoir irrigation canal agricultural waterway pond Japan
screens.subject: A real oblique aerial photograph showing a dam lake or reservoir connected to an agricultural irrigation channel that carries water toward a farm pond. The water channel and pond connection should be visible.

screens.query: agricultural pond watershed connected waterways surrounding land aerial view
screens.subject: A real aerial photograph of an agricultural pond connected to water channels, surrounding land, and human-managed landscape. The pond should not appear isolated from its watershed.

screens.query: pond restoration before after same location archival comparison photo
screens.subject: One existing photographic comparison asset showing the same pond location before and after a restoration or kaibori, with matching views and no embedded captions, labels, logos, or watermarks. If no such single source image exists, reject.

screens.query: aquatic plant ex situ conservation cultivation aquarium water plants Japan
screens.subject: A real photograph of aquatic plants being preserved or cultivated outside a pond, showing plants growing in an aquarium, tank, or propagation container and a caretaker's hands.

screens.query: pond water quality monitoring citizen volunteers water sampling field
screens.subject: A real documentary photograph of people monitoring a pond after restoration, measuring water quality or taking a water sample and recording observations.

screens.query: Japanese irrigation pond embankment sluice gate water channel trees
screens.subject: A real photograph of a managed Japanese pond landscape showing the embankment, sluice gate, water channel, and surrounding trees together.

screens.query: drained pond bed exposed mud litter plant fragments fish habitat
screens.subject: A real photograph of an exposed drained pond bottom with mud, plant fragments, and human litter visible as traces of the pond's history. Do not use a TV or news screenshot.

screens.query: refilled pond calm water surface shoreline vegetation restoration
screens.subject: A quiet real photograph of a pond after water has returned, with calm water, waterside vegetation, and a subtle sense of life beneath the surface.

screens.query: citizen volunteers observing monitoring pond ecology notebook field
screens.subject: A real documentary photograph of citizens or a conservation group quietly observing a pond and taking field notes or monitoring ecological changes. Observation, not active construction, is the focus.

screens.query: human silhouette reflection pond water fish underwater muddy bottom
screens.subject: One real photograph of a person's silhouette reflected on a pond surface, with fish or muddy pond bottom visible beneath the water in the same frame. Quiet composition with open space above.
